case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr. Seidl,

Thank you for your quote and for setting out your cost drivers so openly. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

Our data shows a different picture on delivery:

Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

Still, we would like to meet you on other terms, and the options below give you a longer contract and different payment timings to choose from:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.77; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of these works for you and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We highly value our long-standing partnership and have taken note of your delivery data. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We are pleased to accept the 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms with the AS-14404 index clause from your Option B. In exchange for these extended terms, we can offer a revised unit price of €5.80. 

To summarize our Angebot, we present a price of €5.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Furthermore, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer; we appreciate your continued movement on price. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

To accommodate your pricing needs, we have selected your Option A with 45-day payment terms, which allows us to calculate a more favorable rate. We can therefore propose a unit price of €5.60, representing a substantial step towards your target. 

For our main quote, we can offer a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. 

Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C, and our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We appreciate your continued movement on price and would be glad to arrange a call to discuss the details.

Building on your Option A with 45-day payment terms, we can offer a further reduced unit price of €5.50. This step reflects our commitment to our long-standing partnership and brings us closer to a mutually beneficial agreement.

Our offer provides a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit. As another option, we present a package with a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
